description: The Lectric ONE is where unparalleled creativity and world-class automotive technology converge to create a maintenance-free and truly effortless commute. A symphony of high-performance componentry from the smart shifting Pinion gear box and the Gates Carbon Drive Belt orchestrates a masterpiece - shaping an eBike unlike any other. An aerodynamic frame, color display, and city tires take this riding experience to the next level while hydraulic brakes, brake-activated taillights, and reflective strips offer safety beyond compare.

components.description: The front wheel features a Thru Axle wheel attachment system for tool-free installation. This feature ensures a straight wheel, consistent brake rotor alignment, and handling stability. Remove the wheel in minutes for an easy and light-weight transport.
Hydraulic mineral oil brakes and 180mm rotors (1.8mm thick) offer ultimate stopping power and peace of mind in wet or dry conditions.
A Gates CDC 24-tooth steel rear belt cog is paired with an aluminum CDX 39-tooth front cog providing a ratio-optimized performance to accommodate a wide range of speeds.
Pinion aluminum cranks are 165mm in length.

Gates CDC 113-tooth Carbon Drive Belt System is lightweight and carbon fiber-reinforced. The belt’s performance is nearly maintenance-free while providing a chainless drivetrain that’s clean, quiet, smooth, and strong.
Available with a Standard or Long-Range 48V lithium-ion battery certified to UL 2271 to power your ride for up to 60 miles, respectively.*** The Lectric ONE is also certified to UL 2849.

An external charging port provides riders with the option to charge the eBike without removing the battery. Meanwhile, interchangeable spare batteries can be removed and installed in seconds, doubling your range.

A Bafang Sutto 750W rear hub-motor (1310W Peak) with 85Nm of torque delivers power and speed quicker than ever before. New Stealth M24 technology is 400% quieter*, delivering a hushed motor experience without sacrificing power.
A backlit, heads-up color LCD display with a USB-A port provides trip and battery intelligence on the go. IP-65 rated electrical components ensure greater water and dust resistance.
This rigid fork is fully aluminum and ultra lightweight, featuring a thru axle dropout.
Ergonomic lock-on grips add comfort so you can ride longer. The plastic sleeve inside helps lock the grips into place and also allows the grips to be easily removed.
A heavy-duty side-sweeping kickstand located near the chain stay keeps the eBike upright.
An integrated safety system, featuring a headlamp and a brake-activated taillight powered by the battery allows you to be seen at any time of day.
Quick-release pedals easily detach from the bike for compact transport.
A custom-designed saddle compliments a sportier look while adding comfort so you can ride longer.
An adjustable and removable seat post allows riders to reach a range of heights while maintaining comfort and stability.

All gearbox functions are combined in the Pinion Smart.Shift App, which can be easily paired and customized to suit your preferences. A pre-select feature automatically sets the rider's gears, allowing effortless auto-shifts, while a convenient start-select feature lets riders dictate their starting gear ahead of time, allowing for split-second starts.
Easily adjustable handlebar stem riser includes a quick-release lever to comfortably adjust your handlebar reach to your liking; bring your handlebars toward you or push them further back.
An ergonomic below-the-bar trigger throttle on the left hand side is easily engaged with your thumb while simultaneously eliminating joint fatigue.

20x2.5'' city tires featuring a reflective strip are equipped with 3mm Hippo Skin with an Aramid Floc Breaker. Shark Skin Protection on the sidewall offers pinch flat protection and all-weather reliability. Slime is installed to prevent flat tires at no additional cost.
24 amp controller is IP-65 rated and potted for weather proofing and thermal management.

With the Pinion C1.6i six-speed sealed weatherproof gearbox, shifting is done at the touch of a button – quickly, ergonomically, and intuitively. The system shifts while riding, while stationary, and while under load.

The Gates app is used to measure belt tension sonically. The belt can be plucked like a guitar string while the app uses the microphone on a mobile device to read the vibration frequency and compares it to a chart to determine if any adjustments are needed.

Lectric's Pedal Assist Wattage Regulation (PWR) programming allows for an improved Pedal Assist experience by assisting the rider up to a certain power level for each PAS setting, instead of limiting the assistance by speed alone. Learn more about PWR here.
